# escape-string-regexp upstream oracle

This directory contains the minimal upstream implementation used only as the
M17 differential oracle.

- Repository: https://github.com/sindresorhus/escape-string-regexp
- Revision: `cbc42403142c96923b482604e1f3d627b1956aff`
- Version at revision: 5.0.0
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
- Vendored files: `upstream.js`, corresponding to upstream `index.js`, and
  `upstream.test.js`, corresponding to upstream `test.js`

Generated PolyRust packages do not contain or depend on this oracle.
